nom: Clean & Clear 2-Pack Oil-Free Facial Cleansers with Citrus Scent

segments.oily: Oily-skinned reviewers, including some managing acne at the same time, report the cleanser controls shine and keeps oil in check without over-drying, becoming a long-term daily staple for several.
segments.sensitive: Reactions among sensitive-skin reviewers are mixed: several with rosacea, psoriasis, or eczema report no rashes or irritation even after years of daily use, while others describe the citrus Morning Burst causing burning, redness, and rough, raw patches — with the Night Relaxing formula tolerated better by at least one of the same reviewers.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report the formula cuts shine and keeps oil under control without leaving skin greasy, though a few note they still need a moisturizer afterward.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several managing long-standing or adult acne, report clearer skin and fewer breakouts within two to four weeks; dissent exists though — one reviewer who had no breakouts before starting the product developed persistent, uncontrollable new breakouts and could not identify another cause.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers describe burning, redness, or raw, patchy skin, especially from the citrus Morning Burst, while others with rosacea or acne-prone, reaction-sensitive skin report no redness at all, including one using it daily for about two years.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers managing eczema or psoriasis report it doesn't trigger breakouts or reactions from harsh chemicals, describing the Night Relaxing formula in particular as gentle enough for reactive skin.
concerns.dehydration: The formula is widely described as non-drying and not leaving skin feeling tight or stripped, though several reviewers still recommend following up with a moisturizer since oil-free cleansers can leave skin feeling dry afterward.
concerns.spots: A single reviewer reports her dark spots fading with use; this is too thin a signal on its own to draw a broader conclusion about the product's effect on discoloration.

aspects.libelle: Bottles frequently arrive with a broken pump
Distinct citrus morning scent vs. calming night scent
Rich lather from just a small amount of product
Strong value from a two-in-one pack
Morning Burst formula feels stronger than Night Relaxing
Exfoliating beads feel gentle rather than coarse

extraits.titre: Softness, Moisturizing, Easy to Use BUT so many breakouts! I had none before!
extraits.texte: I bought this as a face cleanser as a change from my regular use brands. I did not have any breakouts what so ever before using this. I take good care of my skin. The first day I tried, after use, it was as if a cool breeze blowing over your face. A great sensation and feeling! (Day one has a better softness and feel for me). Next day, I noticed ONE break out. I let it go, thinking maybe something I eat or the air or something. As days go by, with my benefits of doubt on this product, more and more break out and cannot even control! I rated this product 5/5 for softness, moisturizing, easy to use BUT 1/5 stars for me! From my experience! Now I have to try back actual acne or anti-break out products or see a derm at worse case. Again, this is from my experience, and only this product. I wish I could get a refund, but it's past the timeline.

I have tried this product for 3 days (only day time to start off) and it is an absolute no. My face has never been so dry, bumpy, and red. I didn’t have perfect skin, but it also has never been bumpy until I started using it. It feels good going on the face, but after the product has been rinsed and pay dry, it made my face feel tight. Throughout the day my face has gotten itchy, red, bumpy and dry.

extraits.titre: Take it from someone with sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I am incredibly acne-prone, my skin is very likely to experience redness if a product isn't for me. I also have very sensitive skin as I suffer from psoriasis. I had used both of these years ago and decided to buy them again when I saw them, and I don't regret it at all despite some issues. Just like I have sensitive skin, I also don't do well with strong scents, so the Morning Burst one was a bit too much for me. It has a strong citrusy scent that didn't agree with my sensitive skin. However, my mother doesn't have this issue with scents and she LOVES it! Now, the Night Relaxing one almost feels like a holy grail for me. It's gentle, generates a good amount of soapiness and cleans very well. My skin feels clean and soft, without feeling tight or stripped of essential natural oils. In addition to that, it doesn't really have a strong scent! Just awesome. I use the night relaxing one at every hour of the day I decide to wash my face.

Packaging - the product came in an envelope that looked and felt as though it was used multiple times prior to me getting it. The adhesive was barely there, it was barely closed at the flap/adhesive strip. The product itself was also damaged - the pump was broke and in such a way I couldn't fix it. Not worth the hassle of returning so I switched it with a pump I have. Product - I have always had bad acne and sensitive skin so after years of testing and struggle, Clean & Clear is the only product that works for me on multiple levels. I have oily skin, this keeps that in check while not drying me out. Keeps my acne in check. Love these products but I also use them along with toner and moisturizer and that is just as important!!!

I have been using this product for almost two years with no issues. I do have sensitive skin, rosacea and malar rash. Many facial products have caused rashes but this one has not. Also have not had a broken bottle show up. My orders are on the Subscribe and Save program. Chances are, if you will have a reaction to this, you may not know till you try it. I would not go off just those that have had a reaction.

extraits.titre: Does the job for oily skin.
extraits.texte: Used this product for years it's always worked well with my oily skin. It might not be the product for people with dry skin, but for me it's my "go to".
